items.exampleEn: Our adopted cat sleeps on my bed every night.
items.exampleZh: 我們領養的貓每晚都睡在我床上。

items.exampleEn: Visitors come from all over the world to see the poet's birthplace.
items.exampleZh: 世界各地的遊客都來參觀這位詩人的出生地。

items.exampleEn: She gave her grandson an affectionate hug.
items.exampleZh: 她給了孫子一個充滿愛意的擁抱。

items.exampleEn: Many of his countrymen came to watch him play in the final.
items.exampleZh: 許多同胞都來看他在決賽中出賽。

items.exampleEn: In this story, the stepmother is kind, not cruel.
items.exampleZh: 在這個故事裡，繼母很善良，一點也不殘忍。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather and his old radio are inseparable; he carries it everywhere.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺和他的舊收音機形影不離，走到哪裡都帶著。

items.exampleEn: Her students affectionately call her Grandma Lin.
items.exampleZh: 她的學生都親暱地叫她林奶奶。

items.exampleEn: My daughter's favorite playmate lives next door.
items.exampleZh: 我女兒最喜歡的玩伴就住在隔壁。

items.sentenceEn: The two boys were playmates as children and are still close friends.
items.sentenceZh: 這兩個男孩小時候是玩伴，現在仍是好朋友。

items.audioEn: My stepmother is a great cook, and she taught me to make fish soup.
items.audioZh: 我的繼母很會做菜，她教我煮魚湯。

items.sentenceEn: My stepmother helped me choose my first suit for work.
items.sentenceZh: 我的繼母幫我挑了第一套上班穿的西裝。

items.sentenceEn: For many people, good food and family are inseparable.
items.sentenceZh: 對許多人來說，美食和家人是分不開的。

items.stemEn: The puppy is very ____ and always wants to sit on someone's lap.
items.stemZh: 這隻小狗很黏人，總想坐在別人的腿上。

items.stemEn: When I lived abroad, I was always happy to meet a fellow ____.
items.stemZh: 我住在國外時，遇到同胞總是很開心。

items.passageEn: Mr. and Mrs. Wang have two children: a son and an adopted daughter from Vietnam. The children grew up as playmates and quickly became inseparable. Last year, the family traveled to their daughter's birthplace, a small village near the coast. The villagers were warm and friendly, and the daughter met several neighbors who still remembered her as a baby. Her brother, always thoughtful, took hundreds of photos for her. Now the family often talks affectionately about the trip.
items.passageZh: 王先生和王太太有兩個孩子：一個兒子，以及一個從越南收養的女兒。兩個孩子從小一起玩，很快就形影不離。去年，一家人去了女兒的出生地，一個靠近海邊的小村莊。村民都很熱情友善，女兒還遇到幾位仍記得她小時候模樣的鄰居。她的哥哥總是很貼心，幫她拍了好幾百張照片。現在全家人常常充滿感情地聊起那趟旅行。

questions.questionZh: 王家的女兒出生在哪裡？
options: 日本靠海的一座繁忙大城市

questions.questionZh: 哥哥在旅行中做了什麼？
options: 跟村民學會了說當地的語言
替全家買了很多當地紀念品
幫妹妹拍了好幾百張照片

items.promptZh: 我們家的兩隻狗總是形影不離。
referenceEn: Our two dogs are always inseparable.
The two dogs in our house are always inseparable.
rubricZh: inseparable 表示「形影不離」（例如 are always inseparable；have become inseparable 也正確）
「我們家的兩隻狗」可寫 our two dogs、the two dogs in our house 等

items.instructionZh: 用 birthplace 造一個句子，介紹你或家人的出生地。
referenceEn: My birthplace is a small town in the south of Taiwan.
My father's birthplace is a fishing village near Keelung.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 birthplace（例如 my birthplace is…）
句子要說到你或你的家人
